trendNote: Search interest from Google Trends (British Columbia). Today = the single day of Sep 25, this week = average of the last 7 days, this month = average of the last 30 days. Scaled so the overall highest value (Stanley Park, this month) = 100.

spots.name: Playland
spots.summary: Amusement park on the PNE grounds
spots.why: This month's score was driven by searches from late August through Labour Day (PNE season), and it has cooled off a lot in the past week. Searches for the Halloween event 'Fright Nights' have just appeared, so interest in the October season looks like it is starting.
tips: Opening days change by season, so check the official schedule before you go

spots.name: Vancouver Aquarium
spots.why: More people are searching for discounts, alongside other indoor attractions like museums and botanical gardens. Today's score is above this week's average, which looks like people planning ahead for a weekend outing.
tips: Parking in Stanley Park is paid

spots.name: Science World
spots.why: It is showing up alongside outing searches like 'things to do near me'. The official name is TELUS World of Science, but almost everyone still searches for 'Science World'.

spots.name: Capilano Suspension Bridge
spots.summary: Suspension bridge over a canyon, plus treetop walkways
signals: canyon frights at capilano suspension bridge
spots.why: Searches for its Halloween event (Canyon Frights) and holiday light show have spiked. It looks like people are checking out the seasonal events early.
tips: Seasonal events run on set dates, so check the schedule before you go

spots.name: Stanley Park
spots.summary: Huge downtown park ringed by the oceanside Seawall
spots.why: Searches for 'Astra Lumina', the illuminated night walk in the park, are surging. It has the highest trend score of any spot this month.
tips: Cycling on the Seawall is one-way

spots.name: Grouse Mountain
spots.summary: Mountain with city views, reached by gondola
spots.why: Searches for the Crown Mountain hike, which starts from the summit, have spiked. People often look up the North Vancouver weather at the same time, so they are likely waiting for a clear day for the views.
tips: The summit is colder than the city and can be in the clouds, so check the weather before you go

spots.name: Deep Cove
spots.summary: Seaside village and jumping-off point for kayaking and hikes
spots.why: Many of the recent rising searches are local news, like 'fire in Deep Cove'. So this score may include searches that have nothing to do with visiting.
tips: Parking fills up fast on weekends

spots.name: English Bay
spots.summary: Downtown beach known for its sunsets
spots.why: Searches for the English Bay water temperature are up 400%. People often search for Sunset Beach next door at the same time.

spots.name: Sea to Sky Gondola
spots.summary: Gondola overlooking the Howe Sound fjord
spots.why: Searches for the shuttle and the Sea to Sky Highway are rising together. It looks like people are figuring out how to get there without a car, or planning a scenic drive.
tips: About an hour's drive from Vancouver

spots.name: Cypress Mountain
spots.summary: Ski hill in winter, with a city lookout on the way up
spots.why: Searches for season passes and the shuttle have just appeared, which looks like people getting ready for ski season. The lookout on the way up (Cypress Lookout) is getting searched too.

spots.name: Lynn Canyon
spots.summary: Free suspension bridge and canyon trails
spots.why: It is being searched alongside nearby hikes like Lynn Valley and the Grouse Grind.
tips: The parking lot fills up early on weekends

spots.name: Buntzen Lake
spots.summary: Mountain lake with lakeside trails, a floating bridge, and paddling
spots.why: Searches for camping (+350%), kayak rentals, and the Diez Vistas trail are rising.
tips: Parking fills up on warm weekends, so check the parking rules before you go

spots.name: Granville Island
spots.summary: Island home to the Public Market and artisan studios
spots.why: Food searches are surging, like the island's donut shop and tea company. More people are also searching for Kitsilano Beach at the same time.
tips: Take the Aquabus or False Creek Ferries and skip the parking hunt

spots.name: Canada Place
spots.summary: Harbourfront landmark with a sail-shaped roof
spots.why: Searches for the Canada Place webcam have spiked. It is also the cruise ship terminal, so cruise passengers' searches are likely mixed in.

spots.name: Steveston
spots.summary: Fishing village with a working wharf
spots.why: Most of the rising searches are about local stores. Steveston is also a neighbourhood name, so its score may run higher than actual visitor interest.
tips: Fishing boats sometimes sell seafood straight off the boat at Fisherman's Wharf

spots.name: Gastown
spots.summary: Vancouver's historic old town, home of the steam clock
spots.why: Searches for bars and restaurants are surging. It looks like people are picking it for dinners and nights out.
tips: The steam clock whistles and puffs steam every 15 minutes

spots.name: Richmond Night Market
spots.summary: Summer-season night market open on weekends
signals: why is the richmond night market closing
spots.why: Searches like 'closing date' and 'why is it closing' have spiked. Searches peak on weekends (Sep 19–20) and drop off sharply on weekdays.
tips: Check the official site to confirm it's open before you go

spots.name: Vancouver Art Gallery

spots.why: Searches for 'free Fridays' are surging. Today's score is above this month's average.

spots.name: Fort Langley

tips: Fort Langley National Historic Site is a short walk from the village centre
